item.title: Six Judges Appointed as Permanent Judges of Kerala High Court
item.description: Six additional judges have been appointed as permanent judges of the Kerala High Court, strengthening the judiciary and enhancing its capacity to address case backlogs while ensuring continuity and stability in the state’s legal system.

item.title: Iran targets US Embassy vicinity in Saudi; Israel bombs Hezbollah sites in Beirut
item.description: The Middle East conflict has intensified with reported Iranian drone strikes near the US Embassy in Saudi Arabia and attacks on American bases in Kuwait. Israel continues bombing Hezbollah targets in Beirut, while explosions were reported near Iran’s state broadcaster headquarters.

item.title: Drone strikes damage Amazon Data Centers in UAE and Bahrain; Delivery delays in region
item.description: Amazon Web Services confirmed that drone strikes damaged two data centers in the UAE and one facility in Bahrain, disrupting key cloud services. The attacks caused structural and power infrastructure damage, impacting EC2, S3 and DynamoDB operations.

item.title: ‘Blood Moon’ to Glow Red: When and Where to Watch Total Lunar Eclipse
item.description: The year’s largest total lunar eclipse will occur today from 3:20 PM to 6:48 PM, painting the Moon a deep red hue known as a “Blood Moon.” The event happens when Earth moves between the Sun and Moon, casting its shadow completely over the lunar surface.

item.title: US Alarmed by Iran drone power, Marco Rubio says America makes only 6-7 interceptors a month
item.description: Marco Rubio expressed concern over Iran’s expanding drone and missile production, stating the US can manufacture only 6–7 interceptors per month while Tehran produces hundreds of missiles and thousands of drones.

item.title: Why Indian Stock Markets are closed today; Will trading resume tomorrow?
item.description: Indian stock exchanges, including the National Stock Exchange of India and Bombay Stock Exchange, remain closed on March 3 for Holi. While some states celebrate the festival on March 4, trading will resume on Wednesday.

item.title: US orders citizens to leave 12+ countries; Trump pledges ongoing Military action against Iran
item.description: Amid escalating Middle East tensions, the US has urged its citizens to immediately leave 12+ countries following US-Israel strikes on Iran and Iran’s retaliatory missile and drone attacks. Six American soldiers have died so far, with ongoing military operations in the region.

item.title: AIADMK’s Edappadi Palaniswamy meets Amit Shah; Reviews Tamil Nadu poll strategy
item.description: A day after Prime Minister Modi addressed a public rally in Madurai, the AIADMK General Secretary Edappadi K Palaniswami met Home Minister Amit Shah on Monday night at 10.30 pm. sources said they reviewed the latest political situation and decided to take seat sharing talks soon after the poll schedule is announced.

item.title: Nitish Kumar’s son Nishant set to join JD(U) on Holi? Marks political debut
item.description: While speaking to reporters, Sharwan Kumar said the decision was taken after years of persistent demands from Party functionaries and supporters urging him to step into active politics.

item.title: T20 World Cup 2026 Semifinal: India vs England – Know When, Where & How to Watch Live
item.description: India has reached the T20 World Cup 2026 semifinal after a thrilling five-wicket win over West Indies, with Sanju Samson scoring a brilliant 97*. India will face England in the semifinal on March 5 at Mumbai’s Wankhede Stadium.
